binning.scheme: the qualification runner's ten fixed-width probability bins [0,.1), ... [.9,1]
binning.predictive_ece: token-weighted absolute difference between mean predicted P(Y=1) and observed frequency
binning.class_ece: world-weighted absolute difference between argmax-class confidence and argmax-class correctness
binning.active_count_ece: world-weighted absolute difference between posterior mass on the true active count and argmax active-count correctness

fixed_stratum.structural_statistics_reason: The frozen runner serialized equivalence posterior fields only for population=own_prior. Fixed-stratum rows contain predictions, targets, scores, and truth, but no equivalence posterior. The read-only order forbids reconstructing or rescoring it.

population_provenance.classification: hybrid canonical bridge distribution; neither V2 prior predictive nor the complete V3 prior predictive
population_provenance.own_prior_label_scope: Only the latent structural draws are from frozen V3 priors: V3.5 ProtectStructure from exp(structure_log_prior), cross sign conditional on edge existence, partner reliability and contact response from Bernoulli(.5), and V3.2 temporal components from their frozen priors.
population_provenance.document_generation: The bridge then uses its own fixed 64-slice canonical schedule: deterministic alternating do(action)/joint-policy values, deterministic masks at t mod 13 = 0, V3.5 atomic identity/outcome/partner/contact productions, and a bridge-authored context observation production P(1)=.80 for context 1 and .20 for context 0. Stratum labels cycle but do not alter the own-prior generator.
population_provenance.why_not_v3_prior_predictive: The canonical document is a restricted common-target projection with a fixed intervention and mask schedule. In particular, its context observations are generated by the bridge's .80/.20 rule rather than V3.2 emission_probability, so it is not a draw from the complete V3 likelihood.
population_provenance.why_not_v2_prior_predictive: No V2 latent or parameter prior generates the document; V2 only receives the immutable document through five analysis adapters.

retained_heldout_density_proxy.definition: mean held-out log score on the 79 delivered target tokens per world; this is a retained-data proxy, not a density comparison against separately sampled complete V2/V3 prior worlds
retained_heldout_density_proxy.limitation: The trace contains no separate complete-model own-prior sample population, so mean canonical-world density versus each model's own complete prior samples is not identifiable without prohibited new generation/rescoring.

miscalibration_direction.selection_rule: two largest aggregate predictive ECE values per model; half-specific values and signed mean gaps are also reported
miscalibration_direction.signed_gap_definition: mean predicted P(1) minus observed frequency; positive is overprediction, negative is underprediction

partner.direction: mixed by bin but net overprediction, dominated by the 32,736-token [.5,.6) bin

identity.direction: mixed and asymmetric; net underprediction of P(identity=1), with a large underpredicting [.3,.4) mass and overpredicting [.7,.8) mass
strongly population-dependent and mixed by bin; the fixed-stratum failure has overprediction in [.3,.4) and larger underprediction above .5

outcome.direction: near calibrated in own-prior worlds; net underprediction in fixed-stratum worlds, especially in high-probability bins

own_prior_equivalence_class.direction: systematic overconfidence in the selected equivalence class

own_prior_active_count.direction: the metric changes sign across bins: overconfidence below .4 and severe underconfidence in the [.4,.5) mass bin

mechanical_findings.interpretation: The fixed ten-bin, token-level ECE is dominated by repeated within-world predictions in a few bins. This does not create the signed calibration gap, but it makes ECE a statement about token mass rather than independent worlds and hides within-bin heterogeneity. Sparse-bin noise is not the source of the largest failures: their dominant bins contain tens of thousands of tokens.
mechanical_findings.fixed_stratum_structural_omission: The structural split requested for the fixed-stratum half is a serialization limitation, not a numerical result.

conclusion: The label own-prior overstates the population provenance: it is a hybrid canonical bridge distribution with V3-prior structural draws. V2 partner miscalibration persists in both halves. V3 predictive calibration is good on the own-prior half but identity and outcome calibration degrade in the fixed-stratum half. The severe class and active-count failures are measured only on the own-prior half; the retained bundle cannot support a corresponding fixed-half split.
